## ec1260207f71

**Classification: Suspected shortcut with a reproducible lesson-identifiability failure; plus reproduced contract/authority defects.** I did not modify this audit target.

The exact lawful lesson in `checks/audit/ec1260207f71/counterexample.json` uses seed `2`, easy difficulty, and consecutive sample indexes `33..37`. All five inputs pass the target validator. The first four demonstrations put cyan dots on the upper red bar; the query puts them on the lower red bar. An `upper_only` rival—apply the selected offset-transfer rule only for upper dotted bars and otherwise return the input unchanged—matches all four authoritative demonstration outputs but differs from the authoritative query output. The Racket outputs were obtained with the supported `arcpuzzles apply` command and are retained in `checks/audit/ec1260207f71/racket.json`.

This is not an isolated seed artifact. A 100-lessons-per-band probe found `upper_only` fit all demos and fail the query in 7 easy, 7 medium, and 1 hard lessons. Other branch-only rivals also survived: `left_only` failed queries in 2/3/3 lessons by band, `right_only` in 5/5/2, and `lower_only` in 0/2/4. These per-rival counts may overlap lessons; exact replay examples and denominators are in `checks/audit/ec1260207f71/lesson_probe.json`.

The full battery independently failed two stages: semantic gate reports **no semantic contract declared** (`strict_canonical_like`, `SEMANTIC_WITNESSES`, and `lesson_identifiable` are all absent), and authority sync reports exact-text divergence between active authorities despite execution parity. See `checks/audit/ec1260207f71-battery/checks/ec1260207f71_after_battery_summary.json`, the semantic log, and the authority-sync log.

A repair should add executable upper/lower and left/right branch rivals, guarantee that each complete lesson refutes branch-only solvers, add `lesson_identifiable`, and synchronize selected authority text without changing behavior. No fix was made because audit targets are findings-only.
